request.prompt:
FINAL WHOLE-SOURCE GEOMETRY REPAIR. All complete figures at ONE uniformly VERY SMALL physical source scale. Each full figure including staff/wings/crown/dress must fit in CENTRAL FORTY PERCENT of its own cell, leaving majority of cell completely alpha0. Absolutely NO isolated opaque feather/hair/fleck/speck outside joined body silhouette, no faint decoration, no colored fringe pixels. All hair and feather edges rooted to continuous body, solid staff-to-left-hand grip. Every requested body wholly independent with disjoint bounding rectangles. Keep exact original anatomical handedness and view. Exact supplied original pale adult queen with silver long hair/crown, fitted black/gold armor, long violet-black dress with anatomical RIGHT-thigh slit, TWO large attached violet feather wings, exactly ONE purple-gold staff held in anatomical LEFT hand. Direction of EVERY pose: EAST looking screen RIGHT, true right-facing side view. Draw this actual new view, not a horizontally flipped opposite view. Exactly SIX grounded WALK poses in TWO columns THREE rows in row-major order. Show TWO actual legs and boots, far boot visible emerging naturally from dress hem, preserve long dress/right thigh slit. A=RIGHT slit leg, B=LEFT leg. Frame0 A boot FORWARD PLANTED supporting, B boot trailing; frame1 A supports while B knee bends and foot lifts BEHIND; frame2 A supports while B knee/boot swings FORWARD with air under B sole; frame3 B boot FORWARD PLANTED taking weight and A heel rising BEHIND; frame4 B supports and A right slit knee bends, A boot clearly LIFTED BEHIND with air beneath; frame5 B supports and A right knee/boot swings FORWARD with air underneath ready to plant into frame0. In second half the RIGHT exposed leg MUST be bent and airborne instead of bearing weight. Two opposite legs truly exchange forward/back positions, articulate hips/knees/ankles and torso weight shift; not six poses with same planted leg. At least ONE sole on ground every phase, no floating/gliding. Staff moves naturally with hand but remains same single object, attached wings settle with torso. Every figure ONE wholly connected silhouette, staff shaft solid and continuously gripped by anatomical LEFT hand, no extra/discarded staff or loose crown/hair/feathers. Same actual model/body scale in every pose. Each COMPLETE figure inside central HALF of its own equal cell with huge completely transparent gutters; no bounding boxes touch or overlap, all parts uncut. Pure ALPHA ZERO outside silhouettes, no glow/haze/shadow/floor/gradient/debris/specks/text/grid. Newly authored project-reference motion, not recovered original.
FINAL CRITICAL: tiny full figures with enormous empty transparent padding, no loose pixel/particle anywhere, one continuous whole silhouette per cell, no background halo/shadow/haze. Do not repeat previous tight framing.
